title: The Historical Atlas of New York City
subtitle: A Visual Celebration of 400 Years of New York City's History

description.main: Eric Homberger's atlas of New York City's growth, built from maps, drawings and charts.
description.extended:
A historical atlas of New York City built from maps, drawings and charts, tracing the city's growth across nearly 400 years.

Eric Homberger's text runs from early Native American culture to the present, with Alice Hudson credited as cartographic consultant. The first edition appeared from Henry Holt in 1994 at 192 pages. This revised and updated edition was issued in 2005 by Holt Paperbacks at 208 pages, and its cover carries a photograph of the Flatiron Building.

Homberger is credited as sole author of both editions, and the 1994 hardcover was part of the Henry Holt Reference Book series.

notes: EDITION AMBIGUITY: spine reads Henry Holt. Candidates: (a) 1994 Henry Holt & Co hardcover, ISBN 9780805026498, 192 pp, 29 cm, 1st ed, sepia Times Square cover; (b) 2005 revised/updated Holt Paperbacks paperback, ISBN 9780805078428, 208 pp, Flatiron cover (also a 1998 Owl Book / Henry Holt paperback exists per AbeBooks). Per brief the 2005 revised edition was used because the shelf copy could not be told apart; the 1994 hardcover is the one whose publisher is literally 'Henry Holt'. Lead should check the physical copy (cover image in src/assets/images/books is the 2005 one). Thin sourcing: Macmillan page 403, so descriptions rest on Google Books blurbs, OpenLibrary, Getty record for 1994 and the cover. No Homberger bio source (Wikipedia has no page). Dimensions for 2005 not given in a clean source (OpenLibrary lists '10.8 x 8.2 x 0.6 inches', axis unstated).
